summary: Konami's large-party political-fantasy JRPG series, including the five mainline console RPGs, Japan-only narrative and card spin-offs, the PS2 tactics side game, DS and PSP alternate-world entries, and the modern Suikoden I & II HD remaster routes.

entries.title: Suikoden
entries.definitive_edition: Suikoden I & II HD Remaster for the main run; Sega Saturn as secondary extras

emulation.emulator: Mednafen or Kronos for Saturn extras; DuckStation for original PlayStation comparison
emulation.notes: Keep PC HD remaster as the main route. Use Saturn emulation only for exclusive-content cleanup.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC HD remaster output, plus upscaled Saturn/PS1 comparison routes.

primary.version: Suikoden I & II HD Remaster: Gate Rune and Dunan Unification Wars
primary.why: The 2025 PC remaster has the highest modern fidelity for the first game, with HD backgrounds, updated effects, enhanced sound, auto-save, fast-forward, and conversation-log quality-of-life features. The Saturn version has exclusive extras, so it is a secondary cleanup route rather than the main full playthrough.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam/Windows release of Suikoden I & II HD Remaster at native display resolution. If you want the missing Saturn-exclusive extras afterward, use a legally dumped Japanese Saturn disc in Mednafen or Kronos.

secondary.exclusive_content: Enhanced Saturn port content including new locations, enemies, colors, opening FMV, and documented extra items/events/minigames that are not part of the HD remaster.
secondary.what_to_play: Play only the Saturn-exclusive scenes/areas/minigames after the HD remaster route.
secondary.why: The Saturn port is more complete in specific extras, but the PC HD remaster is the higher-fidelity full-playthrough version.

emulation.notes: Use PlayStation emulation for clean capture of the Japan-only original.
